sections.name: Intro
sections.desc: bright bouncy synth stabs, rubbery bass, crisp drums

lines.text: I will lift You up, my God and King,
Every single day I'm gonna bless Your name.
Great is the LORD, no limit to His greatness,
Nobody can measure all the ways He's amazing.
Passing down the story, never losing the thread.
Talk about Your glory, talk about Your power,
Tell 'em what You did, let it echo louder.
Majestic, mighty, beyond what we can say,
Your works keep giving us a reason every day.
I will think about the splendor of Your reign,
And tell the next generation what Your hands have made.

sections.name: Chorus
sections.desc: short explosive melodic hook, layered vocals

sections.name: Verse 2
sections.desc: faster double-time pockets, dense internal rhymes

lines.text: Everything You made looks to You for food,
You open up Your hand and You give what's good.
You satisfy the living with what You provide,
And all of it comes from Your generous side.
Near to everyone who calls Your name.
You hold up those who bend.
You are near when we call.
You uphold them when they fall.
So I'm putting it in the rhythm,

sections.name: Bridge
sections.desc: beat strips to bass, percussion and vocal chants

lines.text: My mouth will speak Your praise.
Let every creature bless Your name.

sections.name: Final Chorus
sections.desc: full Confetti-style production, rapid ad-libs, stacked vocals

sections.name: Outro
sections.desc: beat cuts into short vocal chant
